s3_operation_budget.authentication_basis: Explicit access key, secret and optional session token are passed only after local preflight; no credential chain, metadata service or STS call.
s3_operation_budget.cap_interpretation: Defensive technical ceiling only, not authorization to retry, rerun, spend, or use all 512 operations.
s3_operation_budget.crash_rule: A reserved nonterminal operation becomes UNCERTAIN at restart and blocks execution pending separate review; reconciliation performs zero network operations.
s3_operation_budget.failure_rule: A failed SDK call consumes its pre-reserved operation and stops; it does not add a retry.
